name: jira-dev-workflow
description: End-to-end Jira ticket workflow: read ticket via Atlassian MCP, create compliant git branch, scope with /grill-with-context, hand off to sdd-python-orchestrator, commit/push via jira-git-committer, close out in Jira. Also ships jira-tech-lead-reviewer, a read-only branch reviewer for tech leads that delegates DDD/SOLID/CQRS compliance to python-suite's reviewers and reconciles the diff against the branch's Jira ticket. Branch-name/author-email regexes and Atlassian MCP knowledge live in this plugin's git-devops-conventions and atlassian-jira-mcp skills; the commit-message format is owned by the skills plugin's commit-message-generator. Phase 6 keeps an approved Markdown summary as the canonical source, then delegates LaTeX authoring and verified PDF export to latex-tools.
